title: SUNET optical-fibre transmission physics map
description: A bounded UPI map of the photon, wavelength, polarization and propagation concepts exposed by SUNET's public optical-network material. It describes the physical layer used to carry information; it does not assert that SUNET experimentally established the underlying laws.
definitions: An optical carrier is electromagnetic radiation guided by a dielectric fibre.
A transceiver converts between electrical data signals and modulated optical signals.
Wavelength and polarization are physical degrees of freedom that can carry or multiplex encoded information.
assumptions: Linear guided-wave optics is adequate for the conceptual map.
Dispersion, nonlinearities, connector loss and amplifier noise require link-specific parameters.
SUNET documents are treated as infrastructure documentation and educational material, not primary experimental papers.

evidence.notes: Public SUNET network description retrieved and hashed.

primary_sources: SUNET public network page and selected historical technical PDFs; see data/sources/sunet_optical_physics.json
falsification_conditions: Falsified as a map of SUNET material if the cited corpus contains no optical-fibre, photon, wavelength, polarization or transceiver concepts.
Any quantitative use fails unless its fibre-specific refractive index, attenuation and dispersion parameters are supplied and dimensionally consistent.
confusion_guard: The map links SUNET infrastructure language to established optics. Website documentation is not experimental verification, and information carried by light is not matter, consciousness or a universal memory mechanism.
